decisions.reason: Original proof 5.2 incorrectly commuted whole refresh maps across operations sharing fault memory. For example, a refresh with memory action H and an intervening other-port fault with memory action X give different retained memory states on |0> when their order is reversed. This invalidates its claimed substitution identity and leaves the recursive conclusions unsupported. The proof repair retains the correctable-range isometry, expands chronological Kraus products into data and syndrome/memory factors, and absorbs only data factors on unused wires. All memory coefficients retain their original multiplication order. The supplier one-fault proofs apply linearly to these local matrix terms; positivity and normalization are inherited from the original circuit.
